descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S15 「同一天重新保存时入院原因不漂移：第 3 天的并发症绝不变成 admitted-with 的原因，重新保存的值替换之前的值」 Admission reason does not drift on a same-day re-save: a day-3 complication never becomes the admitted-with reason, and the re-saved value replaces the earlier one

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Admission Reason has no labeled section with its own Edit button. It shows (a) as the single primary-diagnosis line in the patient header and (b) woven into the Background one-liner, and it reflects …（TFA-92588 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U2 Save Note turns the input into the prototype's summary shape: first a Background (a one-liner with age, sex, reason for admission and significant PMH woven in, then active-issue bullets), then vitals …（UAT TC-10；TFA-92588 AC 1；TFA-92588 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U3 Dictated and typed input both save reliably and both produce a usable summary; Save Note reliably commits the note.（UAT TC-10；TFA-92588 AC 3；TFA-92588 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given The make-session Hospital patient (header diagnosis Community-acquired pneumonia)

When Save a day-1 pre-round, then replace the whole text with a day-3 note about a new fever and C. diff (and a new potassium) and Save Note again the same day

Then The header still reads Community-acquired pneumonia; the Background one-liner's admitted-with clause still names the pneumonia, not the fever, diarrhea, C. diff or sepsis; there is no Admission Reason section with its own Edit button; Labs show potassium 4.6; the course has one line for today and no task or tracker row is duplicated

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：scripts/oracle.mjs: header diagnosis present; none of the drift phrasings present page-wide; no Admission Reason heading or 'Edit Admission Reason' control ('heading "Admission Reason"', not the bare words: the Hospital success message 'Auto-updated: admission reason, …' contains them); potassium 4.6 present. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
